messages:
marta: heads-up — tiny change to the release-notes generator landed in #ci, releasebot queued a minor bump; should we force this to be a patch? cc @devon @leo :eyes:

devon: which file changed exactly? minor seems odd for wording change

marta: it's under tools/release-notes/template.js — releasebot classifies /tools as infra so it defaulted to minor, but it's not runtime at all

leo: prefer patch for docs-only changes. mind if we add an exception for release-note generator files?

samir: +1 patch. also quick side question: do we want to preserve +buildmeta in tags (eg 1.2.3+ci.4567)? some downstream clients choke on buildmeta

devon: we currently strip buildmeta for the stable channel in the deploy pipeline, but not consistently. @release-bot any logs on why minor was chosen?

release-bot: DeployBot v2.4 — releasebot@ci: heuristics: docs-only -> bump.patch if changed paths match ^docs/ or ^content/ or PR label release:docs-only. Changes under ^tools/ are treated as infra -> bump.minor. Override: add label `release:force-patch` or add path exception in config

marta: that's the gap — the generator lives in tools/ but semantically it's docs. we should add a path exception for tools/release-notes/*

leo: agreed. quick config snippet suggestion:

```yaml
# releasebot config
paths:
  docs_paths: ["^docs/", "^content/", "^tools/release-notes/"]
  infra_paths: ["^infra/", "^deploy/", "^scripts/deploy/"]
  docs_only_label: "release:docs-only"
```

devon: also we need a decision on buildmeta: keep in git tags or record as metadata? if we keep it in tags, some semver parsers used by internal infra treat it as non-identical and that causes lookups to fail

samir: my vote: canonical release tag should be semver core (1.2.3). store buildmeta in the GitHub release body and in our release-mapping artifact (release-manifest.json) as `build_meta` so deploy tooling can map version -> sha

marta: operationally that's fine, but rollback playbooks reference tags. if two builds map to 1.2.3 we need deterministic mapping. as long as releasebot writes canonical tag -> sha, ok

leo: we can have releasebot create both: tag `v1.2.3` (canonical) and a metadata tag `v1.2.3+ci.4567` in a separate namespace (refs/tags/meta/...). deploybot will use canonical tag and consult release-manifest.json for exact sha if needed

devon: proposal: release tags on main releases use semver core only. buildmeta is persisted in release-manifest and release body. releasebot to add `release:force-patch` detection if label present OR changed paths are subset of docs_paths

marta: :thumbsup: can we do the config change and a small releasebot patch today? if everyone ok i'll merge the exception and test in staging during the morning change window

samir: I'll open a mini-RFC (PR with config + releasebot change). ETA EOD. I'll include tests that assert docs-only -> patch and that metadata mapping works

devon: sounds good. i'll run a staging job tomorrow in the change window to validate. if it passes we can merge to main and roll out to releasebot

marta: thanks — if no objections i'll approve once the PR is green. :rocket:

devon: lgtm :+1:

samir: thanks, everyone
